summary.short: Suspends, from the date of issue until 10 November 2026, the implementation of MOFCOM/GAC Announcements No. 55, 56, 57 and 58 of 2025 and MOFCOM Announcements No. 61 and 62 of 2025. The text does not describe what those announcements regulate.
summary.long: Joint announcement No. 70 of 2025 by the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and the General Administration of Customs (GAC), dated 7 November 2025, suspending the implementation of MOFCOM/GAC Announcements No. 55, 56, 57 and 58 and MOFCOM Announcements No. 61 and 62 (all 2025). The single operative sentence states that, with approval, the listed announcements are suspended from the date of issue to 10 November 2026. The document has no article structure. It does not describe the content of the suspended announcements, the parties they regulate, their thresholds, penalties or definitions, or what takes effect when the suspension ends. The domain classification (chips_export_controls) is provisional: the text itself does not state a subject-matter domain, and it contains no AI-specific provision.
